name: Curaçao
summary: A blue field with a yellow horizontal stripe below the centre and two white five-pointed stars in the upper hoist. Adopted in 1984 after a competition with over 2,000 entries.
origin: The island council adopted the flag on 2 July 1984, now Flag Day. Curaçao became a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands when the Netherlands Antilles dissolved in 2010.

symbols.name: Two stars
symbols.description: White stars in the upper hoist.
symbols.meaning: Curaçao and its small neighbour Klein Curaçao; also love and happiness. The five points stand for the five continents from which its people come.

facts: Klein Curaçao is an uninhabited island off the coast.
Its design is often compared with Aruba's.
clues: Blue with a yellow stripe below the centre and two white stars.
Its two stars are a main island and a small uninhabited one.
Its blue is both sky and sea.
